meta.source: Visual standards observed on texasmutual.com (2026 redesign stylesheet, txm26-*), rebranded as the fictional Pecos Mutual for demo use.

tokens.name: midnight
tokens.usage: Primary brand dark. Masthead, dark sections, dark cards, solid dark buttons, H2 headline ink on light grounds.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Footer background and deep accents. White text on it = 12:1.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Utility nav links, header links, blue icon set, footer Subscribe button. 6.0:1 on white, 5.5:1 on surface-alt.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Hover fill for dark/white buttons, quick-link hover text, highlight word in big stat callouts on midnight (7:1).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Signature accent on midnight: hero highlight line, outline-button border and label, card headings on dark cards, star divider. 9.6:1 on midnight. Never as text on white.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Icon fill (quick links, value cards), inline body links, quick-link hover underline. As small text on white it is only 3.2:1 — source value kept; use orange-text for links in body copy where accessibility matters.

tokens.name: orange-dark
tokens.usage: Orange hover/pressed state. 4.0:1 on white — large text or icons only.

tokens.name: orange-text
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: accessible orange for body-copy links on white (4.9:1) and surface-alt (4.5:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Strong body / card-heading text on white and surface-alt (10.5:1).

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Source body-copy grey on white. Only 3.6:1 on white and 3.3:1 on surface-alt — kept exact; prefer body-accessible for long copy.

tokens.name: body-accessible
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: body copy grey that passes 4.5:1 on white (5.1:1).

tokens.name: body-light
tokens.usage: Body copy on midnight and navy (8.4:1). Also the hairline rule colour family.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Quick-link labels on the white pill bar.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Page ground, cards on surface-alt, H1 on midnight, footer link text.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Light grey-blue section background; white cards sit on it.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Alternate pale panel (forms, table stripes).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Form field borders, header dividers, table rules.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline beside the star divider (1px, max 216px).

tokens.name: orange-tint
tokens.usage: Pale orange alert/notice background; pair with ink text.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Secondary icon accent / success marks. Icons only (3.6:1 on white).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on light grounds (2px solid, 2px offset). On midnight use gold.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Masthead headline, ALL CAPS, white on midnight; last line in gold. 46px under 768px.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headline, sentence case, midnight on white/surface-alt or white on midnight. 44px under 480px.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big-number callout on midnight, white with one sky-blue line, between two hairlines.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Kicker above an H2; body grey, or gold on midnight.

styles.name: card-heading
styles.usage: Card titles; ink on white, gold on midnight.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We help policyholders build stronger, safer workplaces.
styles.usage: Paragraph copy in sections and cards.

styles.name: link-bold
styles.usage: Stacked orange action links in a section.

styles.name: nav-utility
styles.usage: Top utility row ("Just for:" audience links) in blue.

styles.name: footer-heading
styles.usage: Footer column headings, white on navy.

tokens.name: space-tiny
tokens.usage: Tight gaps (icon-to-label in dividers).

tokens.name: space-small
tokens.usage: Default stack gap inside columns, card grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-card
tokens.usage: Card padding (simple cards; all cards on mobile).

tokens.name: space-med
tokens.usage: Quick-link gap; medium gap on mobile.

tokens.name: space-60
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-70
tokens.usage: Gutter between text column and image in 2-col layouts.

tokens.name: space-80
tokens.usage: Medium gap on desktop.

tokens.name: space-card-tall
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of tall dark cards.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Section top/bottom padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-masthead
tokens.usage: Masthead top/bottom padding on desktop.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width; container is 94% wide (90% on mobile).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, images, inputs — the system is square-cornered.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small UI only (form controls, subscribe button).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The white quick-link bar overlapping the masthead (square on mobile).

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: Linked cards on hover, with an 8px lift of icon/heading.
